_note: Generic 'where is the data' map shipped with the repo. Verified live; no company data. words = trigger words (matched against the user's search); on_models = describe_model shows the pointer for these resources.

concepts.pointer: Rent is not a field on Leases. Rent = the RECURRING CHARGES set up for the tenant: charge type Rent Charge (RC) plus subsidy types (Rental Assistance RA, HAP, MS8 ...), which are also rent. Show tenant portion + subsidy portion = total. Query RecurringCharges with filters 'UnitID,in,(ids)' or 'EntityKeyID,in,(tenantIds);EntityType,eq,Tenant' and summary='rent' (breakdown per tenant by charge type). Do not read rent from the ledger (Tenants/{id}/Transactions): that only holds what was posted/paid. Asking/market rent: Units embed CurrentMarketRent.Amount, or the Vacancy report.

Lease audit (compare the lease with what is charged): lease rent = ALL tenant-paid rent charge types PLUS rental-assistance / subsidy charge types (RA, HAP, MS8...), summed per lease/tenant, compared with the rent the lease PDF states. Sources: (1) recurring charges on the tenant/unit: query RecurringCharges filters 'UnitID,in,(ids)' (or EntityKeyID + EntityType,eq,Tenant); summary='rent' already splits tenant portion, subsidy portion and total per tenant; (2) lease dates/IDs from Leases (StartDate, EndDate, TenantID, UnitID); (3) the lease PDFs: find_attachments (lease renewals, tenant history category Lease/Rider/Renewal; the PDF often sits on an EARLIER renewal) then download_file. Ledger rows (Tenants/{id}/Transactions) are posted history, not the audited rent. A rent roll can have two rows per unit (tenant + subsidy): sum per unit; it has no lease dates or IDs.

Leases (UnitID, TenantID, MoveInDate, MoveOutDate). For the last tenant of a unit: query Leases with 'UnitID,in,(ids)', orderby '-MoveOutDate', first_per='UnitID' (one newest lease per unit, ONE call for all units).

Security deposit held: Tenants embed SecurityDepositHeld (amount, per tenant); built-in reports SecurityDeposit / DepositDetail; deposit postings are ledger rows (Tenants/{id}/Transactions, Description 'Security Deposits'). The Deposits resource is bank deposits (often empty), not tenant deposits.

Current balance per tenant: Tenants embed Balance (query Tenants with embeds='Balance'). Delinquency/aged lists: recipes delinquency, aged_receivables. Ledger with running balance: recipe tenant_ledger (newest first).
Move dates live on Leases: MoveInDate, MoveOutDate, ExpectedMoveOutDate, NoticeDate (not on Tenants or Units). Recipes move_ins / move_outs cover a date range.

Vacant = physically vacant: nobody living in the unit today; reserved or held units (prospect reservation, Rent Ready, Const ...) count as vacant and are flagged in status_flag / occupancy_flag. Recipe vacant_units (list) or vacancy_report (days vacant, market rent, same units + UnitID). Units has no IsVacant filter (IsVacant is an embed; the filter is IsVacantAsOf = strict, excludes reserved units).
Work orders / service requests = ServiceManagerIssues (resource) with ServiceManagerIssueWorkOrders for the work-order detail; built-in reports ServiceOrderList and IssueList.

Ledger = Tenants/{id}/Transactions (TransactionDate, TransactionType Charge/Payment/Credit, Description, Amount; only 7 filters). It is the posted/paid history. One or several tenants: recipe tenant_ledger (tenant list, since/until, newest 1000 rows each, ledger running balance). Pulls are capped (default 5000 rows, the newest are kept, the answer starts with a CAPPED line). A whole property: do NOT loop per tenant; use the report suggestions (report 30 ChargeDetail), recipes payments_received / charges_by_type, or Charges/Payments with date filters.

field_aliases.Rent: not a field: see search_models('rent') (recurring charges)
field_aliases.IsVacant: IsVacantAsOf (filter); IsVacant is an embed only

filter_quirks.RecurringCharges: Spec lists PropertyID and TenantID as filters but the live API fails on them (HTTP 500). Use UnitID, EntityKeyID (tenant id; add EntityType,eq,Tenant), Unit.PropertyID, ChargeType.Name. A ToDate filter drops open-ended charges (ToDate empty), so never filter ToDate when looking for current rent.
filter_quirks.Transactions: Only AccountID, Amount, Comment, Description, MasterPaymentID, Reference, TransactionDate are filterable. TransactionType is not: use local where='TransactionType,eq,Charge'.
filter_quirks.Units: IsVacant is an embed, not a filter. Use IsVacantAsOf,eq,date (strict) or the recipes.
filter_quirks.HistoryNotes: Nested owner filters (Tenant.TenantID, Unit.UnitID, Owner.OwnerID, Vendor.VendorID, Property.PropertyID, ServiceManagerIssue...) fail on the HistoryNotes collection (HTTP 404 or silently 0 rows). Use the sub-resource Tenants/{id}/HistoryNotes (also Units, Owners, Vendors, Properties, ServiceManagerIssues); query routes single-owner filters there itself. Files: find_attachments.

report_suggestions.short: report 30 ChargeDetail (StartDate, EndDate, PropertyIDs; one row per charge with the payments applied, tenant name in AccountsName, TenantID in AccountsAccountID) or, for one tenant, Tenants/{id}/Transactions with a date range (recipe tenant_ledger: since=, until=, tenants=[...])
report_suggestions.text: Tenant ledger / statement / charges and payments, pick the narrowest that fits: (1) ONE or SEVERAL tenants: recipe tenant_ledger (tenant or tenants=[...] list, since=, until=, newest rows first, running balance); it reads Tenants/{id}/Transactions with a date range. (2) All tenants at a property for a date range: report 30 ChargeDetail (StartDate, EndDate, PropertyIDs; one row per charge with payments applied; AccountsName = 'Last, First', AccountsAccountID = TenantID, so keep one tenant with where='AccountsAccountID,eq,<TenantID>'). (3) Totals per tenant: reports 29 ChargedBreakdown (charges) and 25 ReceiptsBreakdown (receipts), StartDate, EndDate, PropOwnerIDs. (4) Totals per charge type for a property: report 1040 ChargesReceiptsDetail with parameters 'BatchProps,True' (summary per charge type, not per tenant; without BatchProps it is empty). (5) Postings with tenant and unit: report 51 GeneralLedger (PropOwnerIDs, StartDate, EndDate; CustomerName = 'First Last', UnitName; many rows). Statements 284 Statement85x11 and 851 StatementOption2 cannot return JSON and their PDF failed in testing. No built-in report takes a tenant filter: filter the rows by tenant name or id.

report_suggestions.short: report 30 ChargeDetail (StartDate, EndDate, PropertyIDs, CHARGESTOINCLUDE; one row per charge) or 29 ChargedBreakdown (totals per tenant and charge type) or recipe charges_by_type
report_suggestions.text: Charges: report 30 ChargeDetail (StartDate, EndDate, PropertyIDs, CHARGESTOINCLUDE; one row per charge with the payments applied and the tenant name), report 29 ChargedBreakdown (totals per tenant and per charge type, PropOwnerIDs), report 1040 ChargesReceiptsDetail with 'BatchProps,True' (charges vs receipts per charge type), or recipe charges_by_type. The Charges collection is huge (hundreds of thousands of rows): always filter by date and, for one tenant, use Tenants/{id}/Transactions.

report_suggestions.short: report 25 ReceiptsBreakdown (StartDate, EndDate, PropOwnerIDs; receipts per tenant and deposit) or recipe payments_received; payments cannot be filtered by property in the API
report_suggestions.text: Payments: report 25 ReceiptsBreakdown (StartDate, EndDate, PropOwnerIDs; receipts per tenant and per deposit), report 30 ChargeDetail (payments applied to each charge, per property), or recipe payments_received. Report 28 AllReceiptsDeposited returns no JSON. The Payments collection cannot be filtered by property and is huge: always filter TransactionDate, and for one tenant use Tenants/{id}/Transactions.

report_suggestions.short: report 18 HistNotesCust (StartDate, EndDate, PropertyIDs, HISTCATEGORYIDS; one row per note with the tenant name) or, for one parent, Tenants/{id}/HistoryNotes
report_suggestions.text: History notes: report 18 HistNotesCust (StartDate, EndDate, PropertyIDs, HISTCATEGORYIDS; one row per note with tenant name and category), or for one tenant/unit/owner Tenants/{id}/HistoryNotes (also Units, Owners, Vendors, Properties). Files on notes: find_attachments. Never pull History unfiltered or with attachments embedded: it runs out of memory.

report_suggestions.short: report 781 RecurringChargeSearch (StartDate, EndDate only; one row per recurring charge) or query RecurringCharges with summary='rent'
report_suggestions.text: Recurring charges: report 781 RecurringChargeSearch (StartDate, EndDate; optional CHARGETYPE, Name; no property filter, about two thousand rows portfolio-wide; one row per recurring charge with EntityKeyID, Name, ChargeType, Amount, FromDate, ToDate), or query RecurringCharges with summary='rent' (per tenant tenant+subsidy portions). Lease audit: include rental assistance (RA) charges as rent.

report_suggestions.short: report 69 SummaryRentRoll (PropOwnerIDs, StartDate, EndDate), 67 RentRoll (AsOfDate), 76 LeaseExpiration (PropertyIDs, CheckedDateRange)
report_suggestions.text: Leases: report 69 SummaryRentRoll (PropOwnerIDs, StartDate, EndDate; one row per unit), report 67 RentRoll (AsOfDate, PropOwnerIDs; detail per tenant and charge), report 76 LeaseExpiration (PropertyIDs, CheckedDateRange 'YYYY-MM-DD - YYYY-MM-DD'), or recipes rent_roll / lease_expirations.

report_suggestions.short: report 51 GeneralLedger (PropOwnerIDs, StartDate, EndDate) or 142 GeneralLedgerUnit (PropertyID, UNITID)
report_suggestions.text: General ledger: report 51 GeneralLedger (PropOwnerIDs, StartDate, EndDate, Basis, GLAccountIDs; postings with description, debit, credit, CustomerName, UnitName), report 142 GeneralLedgerUnit (one PropertyID, UNITID, dates), or recipe gl_activity.
